Agent Crate is a real estate template library that now also sells done-for-you posting and branded post design. The templates are shared across thousands of agents — so your content looks the same as everyone else using Agent Crate.

Is Agent Crate A Done-For-You Service?

Partly. Agent Crate is a template library with optional done-for-you posting plans. On the $59 Create plan, you pick templates, customize them in Canva, and post yourself; AI tools help with captions.
Does Agent Crate Include Video Editing?
Partly. Agent Crate offers Reel templates and ready-made Reels; the Branded plan adds one designed Reel a week from photos you send. There is no editing service for footage you film yourself.
